title: Koleisama ya Mpaka oyo akanisaki te
intro: Na bisika mosantu ya Ndako ya Allah, mosaleli moko ya Nzambe oyo akómaki mobange akutanaki na libombami moko ya mozindo oyo ezalaki koboya bilikya nyonso. Moto oyo amipesaki, kala mingi koleka mibu ya boboti ya bomoto, amonaki likambo moko ya kokamwa oyo emonisaki ngolu ezanga ndelo ya Bonzambe. Puzzle ezali na ko découvrir moment oyo babosanaki uta na bomoi ya ba profeta.
clues: Bato na ngai bayebanaki lokola Yisraele, bakitani ya tata moko monene ya kala.
Nalekisaki butu na ngai na losambo, nafukamaki liboso ya Nkolo na ngai na tempelo.
Bapesaki ngai mwana mobali na bobange na ngai, likabo oyo natikaki te kokumisa Allah mpo na yango.
Momekano na ngai esɛngaki kozwa bilei oyo ebimaki mpo na molimo moko ya elenge oyo ezalaki na nse ya bobateli na ngai.
Nazalaki mosakoli moko na nkombo Zakariyya, oyo bapesaki ngai mokumba ya kobatela Maryam na Bayt al-Maqdis.
Eyano ezali na verset oyo Allah andimaki Maryam mpe apesaki ye bilei.

identity.label: Nazali Nani?
options: Mosakoli oyo azalaki kobatela Maryam na tempelo
Mosakoli oyo atongaki ndako ya bule
Mosakoli ameli na mbisi moko monene
Mosakoli oyo akimaki bato na ye
Prophète oyo alobaki na Allah directement
identity.answer: Mosakoli oyo azalaki kobatela Maryam na tempelo

trial.label: Momekano/Evenement
options: Komekama na bambula ya kokauka
Kozwa bilei oyo epesamaki na ndenge ya kobombama mpo na palwasi moko ya elenge
Kosakola epai ya ekólo oyo eboyaki litambwisi ya Nzambe
Kobwakama na libulu na bato ya moto ye moko
Kozwa emoniseli na nzela ya bimonaneli
trial.answer: Kozwa bilei oyo epesamaki na ndenge ya kobombama mpo na palwasi moko ya elenge

location.label: Elemento ya ntina
options: Masuwa oyo etongami na mabaya mpe na nsɛtɛ
Tempelo mosantu ya Yelusaleme
Elanga oyo ebebaki
Engumba oyo etongamaki na mokonzi moko ya sembo
Bozindo ya mbu

outcome.label: Resultat
options: Bato bandimaki mpe balandaki motindami
Bondimi ya bonzambe mpe mawa mpo na baye bamipesi na losambo
Etumbu eyaki likolo ya baye bazangi kondima
Mwana mobali abotamaki na bobange lokola elakamaki
Koleka na libateli na esobe
outcome.answer: Bondimi ya bonzambe mpe mawa mpo na baye bamipesi na losambo

arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍۢ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًۭا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًۭا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account." (3:37)
